answer: Let each member sponsor few newcomers per epoch by locking a bond behind every cipher invitation: if the newcomer proves a duplicate, the sponsor bond is slashed, so each puppet costs its farmer real money. Then make every account finish a short task inside one narrow onyx window: one human cannot do it for dozens of accounts at once, so parallel puppets fall behind. Finally run walnut clustering on the interaction graph, grouping accounts whose timing and peers match too closely, and demand extra proof from each cluster, since one operator puppets share a fingerprint.
